post.text: Battlefield Hardline servers on consoles will be shut down on June 22, 2026 https://t.co/3dVt5f0lSH

description.description: The image is the promotional cover art for the video game Battlefield Hardline. It features a collage design composed of several smaller vertical and horizontal panels showing different elements of the game's theme. These include a close-up of a man's face, stacks of 100-dollar bills, a firearm with bullets, a tactical SWAT vest, a cityscape with skyscrapers, and a SWAT armored vehicle. Centered across the image is the large stylised title of the game.

A close-up portrait of a bald man with light facial hair wearing sunglasses, a grey button-down shirt, and a tactical vest equipped with shotgun shells, a radio, and a holstered handgun. He is holding a shotgun over his right shoulder. His right arm is visible, showing ornate tattoos and bracelets. The lighting is warm and bright, coming from the side.
